title.narrative: Establishment of a Science Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) academic and research programme at the University of Aruba .

description.narrative: The specific objective is to strengthen the capacity of the University of Aruba to deliver a high education (Bachelor and Master level) and research offer, with a particular focus on STEM subjects.The activities to be completed are:1) Faculty set-up of the SISSTEM, including research facilities and laboratories that comply with the European Qualifications Framework in consortium with the University of Leuven2) Establishment of a Science Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) Bachelor programme which will be taught in English.3) Establishment of a Master programme in Sustainability which will be taught in English4) Facilitation and implementation of research and innovation programmes (at local and regional levels) resulting in PhD graduates, publications, certificate programmes and other research outcomes in the field of sustainability
